I’ve started safely: the WISP-001 branch/worktree is based on merged `main`, and the original Wisp checkout is untouched.

I’m pausing before changing implementation code because the existing WISP-001 plan doesn’t accurately describe the code it proposes to ship: it misassigns acceptance criteria, specifies an API that differs from the implementation, and includes a `wisp status` command outside the spec. The repo’s workflow requires those artifacts to be corrected and gated first. I also confirmed three concrete safety defects to address in that slice: IDs can bypass validation during deserialization, persistence can follow a symlink outside the workspace, and Git can report an ignored, untracked artifact as clean.

The isolated worktree currently contains a copied implementation snapshot, but no fixes have been made. The next sound step is to reconcile and gate the WISP-001 spec and plan, then implement those safety fixes against the approved scope.
Let's fix the docs and specs first with speed please

The WISP-001 drafts are corrected in an isolated worktree at `/private/tmp/wisp-001-foundation`; the original Wisp checkout is untouched.

I updated the [requirement](/private/tmp/wisp-001-foundation/docs/requirements/REQ-WISP-001.json), [spec](/private/tmp/wisp-001-foundation/docs/specs/WISP-001.json), [plan](/private/tmp/wisp-001-foundation/docs/projects/WISP-001.json), and [prose notes](/private/tmp/wisp-001-foundation/docs/spec/WISP-001/02-decisions.md). The changes bring the status command into scope, correct the plan’s criterion mapping and spec hash, and specify the ID-deserialization, symlink, stored-path, and Git-state safety cases. I also corrected the schema checksum in provenance.

`just docs-lint` passes; JSON syntax and plan-to-spec criterion coverage checks pass. I did not run tests. JSON Schema validation and the required independent spec/plan gates are still outstanding, so these remain drafts—not authorization to implement.
Commit and move to the next step until we have enough for a PR

Perform the third and final read-only Sentinel plan-gate retry for WISP-001. Read /Users/gabe/.codex/plugins/cache/wisp-plugins/sentinel/2.1.2/skills/gate/SKILL.md, then inspect the latest plan/spec/requirement and Wisp AGENTS.md. The Scribe spec gate has now actually passed (Wisp CLI validation, hash/source checks, criterion review) and the Navigator challenge has passed; docs/spec/WISP-001/02-decisions.md records both. Check the changed docs and all prior plan blockers against the actual files. Verify criterion coverage, raw spec hash, task IDs/order, file changes, errors and planned test evidence. Read-only; do not edit or persist. Return a verdict@3 object with retry_count=2 and concise exact evidence. Do not claim implementation checks have run.
I’ll perform only the requested read-only plan gate: first read Sentinel’s gate instructions, then inspect the current Wisp artifacts and verify each prior blocker against the files.

input.input: const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git status --short --branch && git worktree list --porcelain && git -C /private/tmp/wisp-001-foundation status --short --branch","workdir":"/Users/gabe/Projects/agent-plugins","max_output_tokens":4000}); text(r.output)

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git diff -- docs/projects/WISP-001.json docs/specs/WISP-001.json docs/requirements/REQ-WISP-001.json docs/spec/WISP-001/02-decisions.md; git diff --cached -- docs/projects/WISP-001.json docs/specs/WISP-001.json docs/requirements/REQ-WISP-001.json docs/spec/WISP-001/02-decisions.md; sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md;","workdir":"/private/tmp/wisp-001-foundation","max_output_tokens":14000}); text(r.output)

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"jq '{tasks: [.tasks[] | {id,title,files,steps,covers_criteria,depends_on}], batches, linked_spec, spec_file_path, plan_file_path, spec_hash, linked_requirement}' docs/projects/WISP-001.json; sha256sum docs/specs/WISP-001.json; jq -r '.acceptance_criteria[].id' docs/specs/WISP-001.json; jq '.acceptance_criteria | length' docs/specs/WISP-001.json; jq '{id, linked_requirement, linked_research, acceptance_criteria: [.acceptance_criteria[].id], non_goals}' docs/specs/WISP-001.json; jq '{id, done_when, out_of_scope}' docs/requirements/REQ-WISP-001.json; sed -n '1,220p' docs/spec/WISP-001/02-decisions.md;","workdir":"/private/tmp/wisp-001-foundation","max_output_tokens":12000}); text(r.output)
